title: Eastern Vesalius
epoch: Planetfall + one standard year and eight days

coordinate_system.projection: Local planar regional grid; campaign travel distances approximate

note: 1,200 × 1,600 km regional extract. Borders show territorial claims, not continuous occupation. Caldrienne and Calvernis extend beyond the sheet.

regions.name: Karsenne Compact
regions.detail: Inland fortress and mining federation. Mountain troops, engineers and defended passes. Essential supplier and uneasy partner of Veyrasse; disputes coastal freight charges and seeks a route through Calvernis.

regions.name: Duchy of Caldrienne
regions.detail: Northern hereditary state. Strong infantry, artillery and the region’s largest tank concentration. Veyrasse’s principal territorial rival; commerce continues under an armed truce.

regions.name: March of Veyrasse
regions.detail: Galahad’s home state. A hereditary margrave shares practical power with houses, councils and industrial patrons. Serravonne is a secondary port and railway junction. Standing army, territorial garrisons and household troops defend the March.

regions.name: Calvernis Republic
regions.detail: Southern commercial republic dominated by shipping, banking and industrial families. Convoy escorts, coastal guns, marines and maritime aircraft. Veyrasse’s trading partner and competitor; potential outlet for Karsenne’s alternative export route.

regions.name: Ceralte Admiralty
regions.detail: Offshore island power ruled by a protector and naval council. Experienced crews, torpedo craft and minelaying. Treaty partner against piracy and hunters; allegations of sheltering privateers remain unproven.

regions.name: Cressault corridor
regions.detail: Disputed by Veyrasse and Caldrienne. Defended valleys, a railway crossing, farmland and pumping infrastructure. An armistice ended the previous war without settling ownership. Occasional frontier fire and mutual accusations continue; renewed war is not declared.

local_approach.note: Upland branch from Serravonne; omitted at regional scale.

history.date: Planetfall + one standard year and eight days
history.description: Initial regional disposition; Cressault remains disputed. No territorial change recorded.
